{{Top}}
'''Bacteria''' was a micro-organism that was potentially harmful to living beings, and could be found in some sources of drinking [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> [[MD-1 medical droid]]s were programmed to work with [[Computer/Legends|computers]] to analyze bacteria, germs, [[Poison/Legends|poisons]], and [[Disease/Legends|diseases]].<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Pretormin Environmental/Legends|Pretormin Environmental's]] [[WPR-60]] [[water purifier]] was designed to eliminate over ninety-nine percent of all known harmful bacteria, viruses or other contaminants through the use of microbiological filtering agents, heating and [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] elements. The resulting water was clean and safe to drink or cook with.<ref name="GFT" />

The existence of bacteria was known at least since the times of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=other|Alien Bacteria, a crafting material}}</ref> Bacteria thrived in the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]'s [[Garbage compactor/Legends|trash compactors]].<ref>{{FactFile|57|DEA 3-4|Death Star – Trash Compactor}}</ref>
